0x70.text: Unstoppable in the thick of it. Huge health, cleaving swings, and every kill feeds the fury.
Holy ground and righteous hammers. Heals himself, shrugs off death once in a while.
Death from range. Arrows, traps and volleys, as long as you keep your distance.
Fast, fragile and lethal. The quickest hero, with crits that delete elites.
Light and Shadow. Shields and heals keep you alive while pain spreads through the horde.
Storms that jump from foe to foe, and totems that fight beside you.
The glass cannon. The biggest area damage in Azeroth, and nothing to hide behind.
Curses and fire. Damage over time stacks up on everything that chases you.
Moon, storm and growth. Roots, hurricanes and the steadiest self-healing.

0xa0.text: Kobolds pour out of Jasperlode Mine, gnolls cross the river and the Defias Brotherhood marches on the farms. Their leader waits for you at the end.
The graves of Raven Hill stand open. Worgen hunt between the trees, and Morbent Fel calls the dead of Duskwood to war.
A demon gate tears open over the gulch. Imps, felhounds and satyrs pour through, and Lord Kazzak follows.
The crater's jungle wakes hungry. Ravasaur packs run the ferns, the pterrordax circle overhead, and King Mosh shakes the ground on his way to the kill.

With the Basin's banners down, the Highlands come for it: Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark trolls out of the hills, and the Syndicate behind them, sent by the last lord of Alterac to take it for his own.
The Gordunni ogres break out of Dire Maul with the Woodpaw gnolls and the wild things of Feralas behind them. King Gordok himself comes to claim the forest.
The Hakkari turn the Arena into an altar. Trolls, raptors and the Blood God's serpents fill the ring, and Hakkar the Soulflayer walks the world again.
The Scarlet Crusade bars the cathedral against the world. Monks and zealots fill the garden and the nave, and at the altar High Inquisitor Whitemane waits to raise the fallen.
The valley wakes. Troggs swarm from the mines, the wolves are starving, and the Ice Lord stirs beneath the snow.
The Dark Iron and the Blackrock clan march out of the mountain together, fire elementals and dragonkin at their side. Above them circles the Lord of Blackrock.
The Scarab Wall has fallen. The silithid swarm and the Qiraji legions spill across the sands, and behind them C'Thun opens its eye.

Naxxramas hangs over the Plaguelands, and its master waits in his frozen chamber. His lieutenants step out of the alcoves where the abominations stand, and when they fall, Kel'Thuzad rises from his throne.
